title: datasample
summary: Randomly sample from data with or without replacement.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs are gathered to host for compatibility until provider sampling hooks exist.

description: `datasample(data,k)` samples `k` observations from `data`. `datasample(data,k,dim)` samples along a selected dimension. `[y,idx] = datasample(...)` also returns one-based sampled indices.
behaviors: `"Replace",false` samples without replacement and requires `k` to be no larger than the sampled dimension.
`"Weights",w` samples proportionally to nonnegative weights with at least one positive value.
Numeric, logical, string, and char arrays are supported.
The default sampled dimension is the first nonsingleton dimension.

faqs.question: Does datasample change RNG state?
faqs.answer: Yes. It uses RunMat's global random stream, like other random builtins.
